tong_selection.selection_rule: minimum phase expectation error on training shots

conclusions: Prioritize the local single-ancilla gadget: Z4 uses 4 instead of 12 entanglers, with population fidelity 0.939 versus compact 0.545 (ladder: 0.936). The hybrid reduces Z6 entanglers 20→14 and phase error 0.413→0.211, but the ladder remains better. Keep terminal software corrections experimental: the Z4 regression repeated; learned XX DD recovered performance only to approximately the original compact level. ZNE shows a tentative phase-error reduction with larger uncertainty; the synthesis search does not beat the routed ladder. Placement differences contribute to cross-construction comparisons.
